## [3.74.0] - 2026-09-08

### Features

- update branch sales ranking dialog to remove compact view and adjust scope provider
- implement sales ranking view options and localization support
- add regional sales ranking feature with localization support
- update automatic close logic to submit zero ending cash for each currency
- enhance automatic session close logic to handle suspended and active orders
- add automatic session close settings and related functionality
- implement automatic session close feature with configurable time

### Bug Fixes

- guard async cart updates

### Other Changes

- Fix customer selector sync page import
- Use large compressed POS sync requests
